name: Tumour Histology and Multi-omics Explorer
description: Index of the explorer's data files with checksums and schemas
notes: The selected analysis panel is one selection for one study design. General availability per TCGA project is reported separately and is larger; do not mix the two.
Spatial studies come from patients other than those in TCGA. They add tissue context, not measurements for TCGA patients.

Spatial resources are shown at two image levels. "Original H&E located": the original scan, measured expression and coordinates were found. "Matched data with preview image": expression and coordinates match a released preview image, and the original scan was not located; such data support molecular spatial maps, not whole-slide or tile models, cell morphology, physical distances or registration sign-off. Registration, calibration and tissue QC may be pending at either level.

Spatial section records are per study, not globally unique physical sections or independent assays. Patients are study-local IDs given by the source; sections without one add no patients, and no eligible-patient total is established.
Counts reported by a study keep that study's own unit (sections, slides, samples, donors) and are never added across studies. An unknown count is absent, not zero.
Normal tissue comes from patients with cancer, not healthy donors.
There is no treated TCGA reference set: treatment-flagged patients were withheld, not collected as a treated group.
The pooled glioma cohort (TCGA-LGG and TCGA-GBM) is a classification benchmark; integrated WHO CNS5 diagnoses are not adjudicated.
Data remain at their original repositories. Listing a dataset does not mean access has been granted or requested.

files.description: Release version, date and the dates on which sources were checked
Cancer types: page codes, panel rationale, linked TCGA project and analysis cohort, histology strata, summary and gaps
Published archetype studies used as the panel's selection history
Studies and resources in every data layer, with image level, linkage, access, open checks, reported counts and the spatial and package review details
Located spatial transcriptomics tissue section records, one per study and section, with measured expression, coordinates and the original H&E or a preview image (image_level)
TCGA molecular screen: patients with RNA-seq and 450k methylation per project, before and after assay-quality exclusions, with normal tissue
TCGA selected analysis panel: counts per project after assay QC, after the patient screen and selected, and the 18 analysis cohorts
Per-patient RNA-seq and 450k states (retained, excluded, unresolved, absent) for tumour and normal tissue
Per-patient treatment and diagnosis screen, analysis cohort, study role and published annotations, as reason codes
Every excluded or unresolved TCGA aliquot with its reason and the layers still retained
Histology review of TCGA-ESCA and TCGA-PAAD cases, cohort definitions and the patient scope review
Links to current GDC data, PanCanAtlas files, histology sources and reference publications
Related leads that add no resources or patients: unassigned releases, precursor studies and reuse records
